name: dsh-tool-medagent
description: 'Medical AI Agent - Clinical decision support, EHR coding, quality control, drug safety, lab interpretation, treatment pathways, patient risk stratification, and medical documentation'

skills.name: Clinical Decision Support
skills.description: Provides evidence-based differential diagnosis, treatment recommendations, and urgency assessment from patient case data. Includes ranked diagnosis with probabilities, treatment plan, and clinical confidence scoring.
examples: Use Clinical Decision Support to provides evidence-based differential diagnosis, treatment recommendations, and urgency assessment from patient case data. Includes ranked diagnosis with probabilities, treatment plan, and clinical confidence scoring.

Invoke Clinical Decision Support with the relevant data and return the formatted result.

skills.name: Ehr Coder
skills.description: Analyzes clinical notes and suggests appropriate ICD-10, CPT, SNOMED, or DRG codes. Provides documentation gap analysis, specificity suggestions, and compliance flag detection.
examples: Use Ehr Coder to analyzes clinical notes and suggests appropriate ICD-10, CPT, SNOMED, or DRG codes. Provides documentation gap analysis, specificity suggestions, and compliance flag detection.
Can you run Ehr Coder? Clinical Notes is the main input I have.
Invoke Ehr Coder with the relevant data and return the formatted result.

skills.name: Quality Controller
skills.description: Evaluates medical record quality against configurable standards (Joint Commission, Meaningful Use). Scores completeness, medical necessity, timeliness, and clinical content. Generates benchmark comparison and improvement actions.
examples: Use Quality Controller to evaluates medical record quality against configurable standards (Joint Commission, Meaningful Use). Scores completeness, medical necessity, timeliness, and clinical content. Generates benchmark comparison and improvement actions.

Invoke Quality Controller with the relevant data and return the formatted result.

skills.name: Drug Safety Checker
skills.description: Checks medication list for drug-drug interactions, dose appropriateness (including renal dosing), allergy cross-reactivity, and generates monitoring recommendations. Returns safety score and risk level.
examples: Use Drug Safety Checker to checks medication list for drug-drug interactions, dose appropriateness (including renal dosing), allergy cross-reactivity, and generates monitoring recommendations. Returns safety score and risk level.

Invoke Drug Safety Checker with the relevant data and return the formatted result.

skills.name: Lab Interpreter
skills.description: Interprets laboratory results by flagging abnormal values (including critical values), providing clinical significance analysis, trend comparison with previous values, and suggested follow-up actions.
examples: Use Lab Interpreter to interprets laboratory results by flagging abnormal values (including critical values), providing clinical significance analysis, trend comparison with previous values, and suggested follow-up actions.

Invoke Lab Interpreter with the relevant data and return the formatted result.

skills.name: Treatment Pathway
skills.description: Generates personalized evidence-based treatment pathways for common diagnoses (T2DM, hypertension, pneumonia). Provides stage-based milestones, alternative approaches, and expected outcomes with probabilities.
examples: Use Treatment Pathway to generates personalized evidence-based treatment pathways for common diagnoses (T2DM, hypertension, pneumonia). Provides stage-based milestones, alternative approaches, and expected outcomes with probabilities.

examples: Use Patient Risk Stratifier to calculates patient risk scores using validated models (ASCVD Pooled Cohort, Diabetes Risk). Identifies modifiable vs non-modifiable risk factors, provides prevention recommendations, monitoring plans, and referral suggestions.
